User.title: User
User.description: A user of the LumenAI application.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

serviceLocations.description: The areas or cities where the installer provides services. Only for installers.

companyName.description: The installer's company name. Only for installers.

companyDescription.description: A short description of the installer's company and services. Only for installers.

pricingDetails.description: A description of the installer's pricing model (e.g., '$$ - Competitive'). Only for installers.

latitude.description: The latitude of the installer's primary location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the installer's primary location.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A solar product listed by an installer.

Query.title: Query
Query.description: A message sent from a homeowner to an installer.

homeownerId.description: The UID of the homeowner sending the query.

homeownerName.description: The display name of the homeowner.

homeownerPhotoUrl.description: The photo URL of the homeowner.

installerId.description: The UID of the installer receiving the query.

installerName.description: The company name of the installer.

location.description: The homeowner's location (e.g., city or address).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the query was sent.

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: A post in the community forum.

ForumComment.title: ForumComment
ForumComment.description: A comment on a forum post.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public information about a user.

/users/{userId}/queries/{queryId}.description: Stores queries sent by homeowners to this installer.

/queries/{queryId}.description: A top-level collection of queries for easy fetching by homeowners.

/users/{userId}/products/{productId}.description: Stores products listed by an installer.

/forumPosts/{postId}.description: Stores all posts for the community forum.

/forumPosts/{postId}/comments/{commentId.description: Stores comments for a specific forum post.
